description: Header file defining the rx::TextureStorage9 class and its derived classes for managing D3D9 textures, including 2D, cube, and EGLImage textures, within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TextureStorage9
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D9 texture storage, providing interface for surface and texture retrieval, and data management.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_2D
classes.description: Concrete class for 2D D3D9 textures, supporting surface retrieval, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
classes.description: Concrete class for EGLImage-backed D3D9 textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
classes.description: Concrete class for cube map D3D9 textures, supporting surface retrieval and mipmap generation.

methods.name: GetTextureUsage
methods.description: Static method to determine texture usage flags based on internal format and render target status.

methods.name: getPool
methods.description: Returns the D3D pool type for the texture.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns usage flags for the texture.

methods.name: getSurfaceLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the surface level of the texture.

methods.name: getBaseTexture
methods.description: Retrieves the base D3D texture object.

methods.name: isRenderTarget
methods.description: Indicates if the texture is a render target.

methods.name: isManaged
methods.description: Indicates if the texture is managed.

methods.name: supportsNativeMipmapFunction
methods.description: Checks if native mipmap functions are supported.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mipmap levels.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets texture data from an image.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target for a specific image index.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies texture data to another storage.

methods.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
methods.description: Constructor for cube map texture storage.
